summary: Spend a semester at IIT Gandhinagar on faculty-supervised research, earning up to 16 credits of research engagement in 4-credit modules.
eligibility: Final-year BTech/BS (4-year) or integrated MSc/BS-MS (5-year) students at IITs, IISc, NITs and IISERs with CPI/CGPA above 8.0.
title: IIT Gandhinagar Visiting Students Research Engagement Programme (Sem II 2026–27)

prize.description: ₹5,000 for each quad in which the student earns B or above (up to about ₹20,000 per semester). No tuition fee; hostel and mess paid by the student.

notes: Separate from IITGN's SRIP summer programme.
The amount is per quad and depends on grades, not a fixed monthly stipend.
support: No tuition fee · hostel and mess paid by the student
